title_sq: Vile 2-kateshe per shitje prane Tv Klan
description_sq:
Shesim vile 2-kateshe prane Tv-Kanit ,me siperfaqe totale prej 170m2.
Kati 0 ka nje ambient komercial prej 43m2 i cili mund te shfrytezohet per lloje te ndryshme biznesi.
Kati 1 ka nje apartament 3+1 i organizuar ne nje korridor i cili ben shperndarjen neper dhoma dhe ne sallon, nje tualet dhe nje verande.
Vila eshte e mirembajtur nuk ka nevoje per investime bazike gjithashtu shitet e mobiluar.
Vendodhja e viles ka te gjitha facilietet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode ndodhet prane shkollave,kopshteve /cerdheve spitalit dhe instiucione te tjera.
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni !
title_en: 2-storey villa for sale near TV Klan
description_en: We are selling a 2-storey villa near Tv-Kani, with a total area of ​​170m2. Floor 0 has a commercial area of ​​43m2 which can be used for different types of business. The 1st floor has a 3+1 apartment organized in a corridor which distributes it between the rooms and the living room, a toilet and a veranda. The villa is well maintained, there is no need for basic investments, it is also sold furnished. The location of the villa has all the necessary facilities for a more comfortable life, it is located near schools, kindergartens, hospitals and other institutions. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
